title: Paytm expands into agentic AI with Pi to offer AI agents to banks, lenders and insurers in India and the UAE
description: Indian digital payments major Paytm has launched the agentic AI service Paytm Intelligence (Pi) to sell AI agents to banks and insurers in India and the UAE. Paytm expands into agentic AI with Paytm Intelligence (Pi) According to recent reports, the company will start selling artificial intelligence agents to enterprise customers, such that bots can automatically handle a variety of workloads and tasks with minimal supervision. With this, Paytm is entering the AI space from handling digital payments for consumers and businesses, and related services like loans and investing. The new Paytm Intelligence can deploy AI agents across functions such as sales, customer service and operations. As reported by Bloomberg, it will initially target banks, smaller lenders, insurers and other financial institutions in India and the United Arab Emirates. Notably, Stripe LLC bought OpenRouter Inc. last month to push deeper into the infrastructure powering the AI boom. Klarna Group Plc has made AI pacts with Google and OpenAI. According to the Bloomberg report, Paytm has already begun offering Pi to a few customers and is planning to expand it to others soon. Founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma in 2010 and publicly listed as One97 Communications Ltd., Paytm started by offering prepaid mobile recharges but soon moved on to digital payments and banking.
